headline: Orwell's Animal Farm On Sale Today; Satire of Soviet Rule Reaches British Readers
dispatch: Victor Gollancz having refused it and other publishers hesitant, George Orwell's allegorical novella Animal Farm was finally released by Secker and Warburg in London on Friday. The slim book depicts farm animals overthrowing their human master only to fall under a harsher pig dictatorship, a thinly veiled portrait of the Soviet revolution and Stalinist rule. Early copies sold quickly, with reviewers calling the fable both charming and politically explosive.
answer: George Orwell's Animal Farm published in Britain, 1945
